title: ClinVar (public-domain) variants-in-cancer-genes pack
context: ClinVar is a US-government public-domain resource aggregating variant-condition associations; it is one of the highest-value Priority-A sources for cancer-relevant variant information. Filtered to variants in known cancer genes and framed as aggregate research evidence (not individual clinical interpretation), a ClinVar track adds significant value alongside the CIViC pack. The aggregate/de-identified nature of ClinVar data means the re-identification check in the license gate is expected to PASS, but must still be explicitly run and recorded.
objective: Build the ClinVar variants-in-cancer-genes pack filtered to cancer-relevant genes on hg38, emitting all three browser targets, with the licensegate-002 re-identification check explicitly run and committed, and per-feature provenance to ClinVar variation IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is ClinVar (US-gov public domain); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed including the re-identification check (aggregate source confirmed); pack carries not-medical-advice notice and is framed as aggregate evidence, not individual clinical interpretation.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; coordinate convention (1-based VCF) handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted (UCSC + JBrowse 2 + IGV) and render-verified; features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/pack-012.json.
Per-feature provenance records ClinVar variation IDs, source release version, and public-domain license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or adoption blocker recorded in outcomes/pack-012.json.
resources: ClinVar FTP and API (NCBI, public domain): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/
output: output/packs/clinvar-cancer-genes-hg38/ — VCF/bigBed track file(s), browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/pack-012.json.
